evidence.reason: failureRowsOf only emits round-level rows when at least one round has failedAttempt, and then filters out every round without one. The surrounding code already supports branchless failure rows: round.outcome, round.gate, and round.reason are used without requiring failedAttempt, and the final fallback row omits branch/sha. So a failed round recorded without a retained artifact is silently dropped; if the task was later fixed and no task.failedAttempt exists, the function returns [] and loses the failure history entirely. That contradicts the documented one-row-per-failed-round behavior. This is an ordinary correctness repair, not a new requirement.
